title.zh: 条形图 · 让数字站成一排比高矮
title.en: Bar Charts · Numbers Standing in a Row

desc.zh: 一排柱子把数字变成长度：读得出谁高谁矮，也看得出平均线把高出和不足补平。
desc.en: A row of bars turns numbers into lengths: see who is taller, and watch the average line balance the highs against the lows.
